label: floor plans processed
method: plan images scraped from 26 Greystar SF buildings, every one run through the classical reader (sweep/sweep.json): 372 readable, 67 unreadable, 5 not a plan

label: apartments rebuilt as walkable 3D
method: units in layouts/index.json (layout with >= 2 rooms, opens in apartment.html), from 23 buildings; 82% of the 439 plan images

label: rooms detected
method: sum of rooms over the walkable layouts

label: doors detected
method: openings of type door over the walkable layouts (plus 806 cased openings)

label: windows detected
method: openings of type window over the walkable layouts

label: floor plan to 3D-ready layout, median
method: wall clock of a fresh Python process per plan (imports + plan_engine geometry path = `layout --novlm` + rooms_export), 30 seeded random plans on an Apple-silicon laptop CPU, 5 of 30 rejected (not a plan / < 2 rooms) and excluded; excludes the optional cached VLM naming/fixture call

label: page load to first rendered 3D frame, median
method: headless Chrome (Playwright) on apartment.html?quality=low, navigation start to the first presented frame of the built scene; software GL (SwiftShader), so a real GPU is faster

label: floor plan to walkable 3D apartment, median
method: sum of the two medians above (plan_to_layout_s + first_frame_s); geometry path, no VLM call

label: scale error from door widths alone (no printed dims)
method: median |m_per_px(door width 0.86 m) / m_per_px(printed room dims) - 1| per plan, plans whose printed dimensions plan_reader transcribed

label: room width/depth error vs printed dimensions
method: median abs % error of each rectangular room's detected width and depth vs its printed dimensions, scale fitted on the OTHER rooms of the plan (leave-one-room-out), 160 dimensions in 33 plans

label: unit area error from door widths alone vs printed sq ft
method: median |sum of room areas at door scale / (0.85 x printed sq ft) - 1|, signed median -21.6%; before the area rule (after it the error is 0 by construction)

label: CubiCasa5K rooms recovered (IoU >= 0.5), untrained
method: share of ground-truth indoor rooms in 96 seeded test-split plans whose best-overlapping detected room has IoU >= 0.5; classical vision, no training; the paper's trained CNN reports 57.5% room-class mIoU (different metric)

label: CubiCasa5K doors found, untrained
method: GT doors with a detected door on the same wall line, 96 plans; window recall 5.0%
